blind_reader_feedback: 60/100 - bare noun pair, no predicate; 早收季 does not say early harvest of what; only bullet in the block with neither predicate nor dash/colon gloss.

stage3.output: 正值鲜软椰枣与早熟椰枣的时节
stage3.notes: Localizer. Two defects fixed, no fact added. (1) 'Of what': 早收季 is replaced by 早熟椰枣. The Arabic arbiter's البواكير is the early date varieties, not an abstract harvest period, so naming the fruit is a disambiguation toward the arbiter, not an addition. 早熟 is the wording already published for the same thing in the spring bullet (头茬早熟的鲜软椰枣) and in the fruits card name 早熟与本地品种（Bawakir）. (2) Predicate: 正值……的时节 is the direct equivalent of موسم / 'season' - it states only that summer is the season of these two things, which is all the source states. Rejected: 上市 / 开摘 / 开始 (events or onsets the source does not state; the spring card already places the first rutab in late May), 率先 or any ranking, any date. Legacy 鲜软椰枣 kept as instructed.

stage4.output: 正值鲜软椰枣与早熟椰枣的时节
stage4.notes: Benchmarker. Before -> after: '鲜软椰枣与早收季' -> '正值鲜软椰枣与早熟椰枣的时节'. Register check against sibling bullets: now a full predicate phrase like '探访古迹与城堡的黄金时节' (winter) and '理想的游览月份就此开始' (autumn), the two lines the blind reader rated most natural; 时节 echoes winter's 黄金时节 without copying a neighbour's predicate. Avoids the next bullet's '正当季' wording. The two coordinated items are now parallel (X椰枣 与 Y椰枣), which removes the food-plus-time-period mismatch the reader flagged. Compared with runner-up '鲜软椰枣与早熟椰枣当令': 当令 is correct and shorter but bookish for a homepage card and less instantly parsed by a general mainland reader, so it is second. Also rejected: '鲜软椰枣与早熟品种当令' (品种 of what is again left to inference), '椰枣季：鲜软椰枣与早熟品种' (still no predicate), full termbase name '早熟与本地品种（Bawakir）' in the bullet (a card title with Latin gloss; too heavy for a one-line bullet, and 本地品种 is not in the EN source or in this Arabic line).

stage5.output: 正值鲜软椰枣与早熟椰枣的时节
stage5.notes: Proofreader checklist. (1) Punctuation: PASS - no punctuation in the string, no trailing mark, consistent with sibling bullets. (2) Termbase: 早熟 taken from the Bawakir entry 早熟与本地品种（Bawakir） - PASS as a descriptive short form (the entry is a category/card name; the bullet does not use the proper name, so no gloss is required). rutab: legacy 鲜软椰枣 kept by instruction instead of termbase 软熟鲜椰枣 - NOT FIXED, pre-existing, still open from loop 0. (3) Numbers/units: PASS - none. (4) Grammar/script: PASS - Simplified only; 正值……的时节 is well-formed; the repeated 椰枣 is deliberate parallelism. (5) Structure: PASS - plain string, no markup. Fact check against source: no 'first', no date, no market event, no place name added; the claim removed in loop 0 stays removed.

final_zh: 正值鲜软椰枣与早熟椰枣的时节
runner_up: 鲜软椰枣与早熟椰枣当令
rationale: Adds the neutral season predicate that موسم / 'season' already carries (正值……的时节) and says what is early (早熟椰枣, per the Arabic arbiter البواكير and the published spring/fruits wording), which answers both blind-reader objections without any new fact. Runner-up is the same content with the compact predicate 当令: correct and subject-first like the next bullet, but more bookish. Not re-read by a blind reader yet; the rutab termbase deviation (鲜软椰枣 vs 软熟鲜椰枣) remains open.
